text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第1批 · 05 · 晨雾里的石桥小径.
Environment: A richly observed film set with a specific emotional story, original architecture and arrangement, not a replica of a film frame. Vicky aesthetic: luminous high-key exposure with retained highlight detail, cream white, pale gray, warm natural brown, restrained pastel accents, broad soft daylight, filled low shadows, fine natural material texture and wear, very subtle film halation and grain, elegant believable photographic realism. Eye-level natural 50mm perspective, layered foreground/midground/background, gentle depth separation but environment clearly readable. Space reserved at central lower midground for future character compositing. ABSOLUTELY EMPTY ENVIRONMENT: no people, no characters, no animals, birds or insects, no human silhouettes, no human reflections, no hands, no faces on paintings, posters or screens, no statues or mannequins. No logos, watermarks, readable text. Avoid CGI real-estate renders, sterile showrooms, excessive bloom, orange grading, deep black shadows, ultrawide distortion. Scene: English countryside shortly after dawn in late spring, a small weathered pale stone footbridge crosses a narrow still stream at midground, softly curving footpath from lower right leads over it to a distant honey-stone manor partially hidden among trees. Soft rolling meadows and layers of thin silver morning mist; pale blue-white luminous sky, soft fresh sage greens, ivory wildflower patches. Camera standing beside a low worn timber gate in foreground, natural 50mm compression, no wide aerial view, an intimate navigable path and clear central stopping place on bridge. Soft front-side light through haze, no strong orange sunrise. Research inspiration: Pride & Prejudice's romantic English landscape and expressive natural light, newly designed setting. Emotion: a morning meeting that has not yet happened. No animals, birds or distant walkers whatsoever.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 电影场景第1批 · 05 · 晨雾里的石桥小径. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions.
